title: Hearty Nutty Italian Yukon Gold Potatoes Focaccia
description: A creamy and nutty Italian dish featuring Yukon gold potatoes in a focaccia form, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This halal-friendly recipe is a delicious and satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Boil the cubed potatoes in salted water until they are tender, then immediately transfer them to an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the toasted pine nuts to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Roll out the thawed focaccia dough to a thickness of 1/2 inch and place it on a baking sheet.
Top the focaccia dough with the cooled potatoes, shaved grana padano cheese, salt, and black pepper.
Drizzle the garlic and pine nut mixture over the top of the focaccia.
Bake the focaccia in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until it is golden brown.
Remove the focaccia from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
